minor.issue: Returns HTTP 502 on AI failure. Through the public ingress Cloudflare replaces the 502 body with its own HTML page, so the Indonesian detail ('Gagal memanggil AI Vision: 401 Invalid token') never reaches the browser - the UI toast shows the raw English Cloudflare text. Verified: localhost:8001 returns JSON 502, public URL returns text/html 502. Use 400/500 (or 200 + error field) instead of 502.

Configured provider key is rejected (401 'Invalid token' from https://www.chenzk.top/v1) and Gemini image quota = 0, so every AI endpoint fails. Routes/validation/permissions are correct; only the credential is unusable.
No duplicate-name validation - two categories with the identical name/type can be created (observed during seeding).

No brute-force lockout: 6 consecutive wrong passwords all return 401 and the correct password still logs in immediately (playbook item 4 not implemented). bcrypt hashes are correct ($2b$12$) and seed_admin re-hashes when the env password changes.
sku is a required non-nullable string; sending sku: null returns 422. Confirm the Products UI never posts null for F&B products.

integration_issues.issue: Parse failure is handled without crashing (dialog stays, spinner clears) but the toast displays the Cloudflare English message 'The origin web server returned an invalid or incomplete response to Cloudflare...' because the 502 body is not JSON. apiError() should fall back to the generic Indonesian message when response data is not an object/string-detail.

rca_of_the_issue: AI invoice parse toast shows an English Cloudflare message: server.py raises HTTPException(502) when the OpenAI-compatible vision call fails; the Kubernetes/Cloudflare ingress treats an origin 502 as a gateway error and substitutes its own text/html error page, discarding the FastAPI JSON body. axios then has e.response.data as an HTML string, and Inventory.jsx passes e.response?.data?.detail (undefined for a string body) -> apiError returns the generic message only if detail is null, but sonner rendered the HTML-derived text because data is a string. Fix at both layers: non-502 status code in backend + non-JSON body guard in apiError.
